title: Recessed Toilet Paper Holder 6.125-Inch Solid Brass | Oil Rubbed Bronze | Carolina Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom storage with a recessed toilet paper holder that saves space and creates a streamlined, built-in look in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom.

  • Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Clean install: Concealed screw mounting hardware.
  • Built to last: Brass construction with a designer finish for corrosion-free and rust-free performance.
  • Ready to install: Includes recessed toilet paper holder and all installation hardware; no assembly required.

Specs

  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting type: Recessed
  • Overall size: 6.125 in L x 4 in W x 6.125 in H
  • Projection: 4 in
  • Product weight: 2.4 lb
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
